data.name: permissions_grant_help
data.value: Gives a user rights in this room, for the bot only. Syntax: -grant user, right[, duration]. In PM, add the room at the end. The right is a rank (+, % or @), a command (e.g. add-badge) or a category (e.g. category:Badges). Durations: 30m, 12h, 3d, 2w. Without one, the right lasts until -revoke.

data.name: permissions_revoke_help
data.value: Removes a right given with -grant. Syntax: -revoke user, right. In PM, add the room at the end.

data.name: permissions_list_help
data.value: Lists the rights given in this room. Syntax: -grants [user]. In PM: -grants [user,] room.
